guide.summary: A direction word after a verb says where the action goes: 进来 come in, 拿出去 take out, 站起来 stand up. 来 means toward the speaker, 去 means away. The one idea: the verb says how, the complement says which way, and a place word must sit before 来/去 (回家去). The same endings also carry fixed extra meanings: 起来 start or judge, 下去 keep going, 下来 settle or record, 出来 figure out or produce, 上 attach or achieve.

subs.label: 来 or 去: where is the speaker?
subs.focus: Choose 来 or 去 after 进/出/上/下/回/过 from where the speaker is. Each item needs a clause fixing the speaker's position (我在楼上, 他不在这儿). Classic mistake: picking by English come/go, e.g. 我在楼上，你快上去吧. Avoid 'going to the listener' cases (我马上过去/过来): both occur.

subs.label: Verb + direction + 来/去 (走进来, 站起来)
subs.focus: Pick the right direction word (上下进出回过起) and the order action verb + direction + 来/去. Classic mistakes: wrong direction word (站上来 for 'stand up'), 起去 (does not exist), reversed order (进走来), direction word left out (从包里拿来 for 'take out').

subs.label: Place goes before 来/去 (回家去)
subs.focus: Put a place object (家, 教室, 楼, 北京) between the direction word and 来/去, not after 来/去. Standard-usage mistake: 回去家, 走进来教室, 上去楼. 回来北京 / 回去学校 are said colloquially: order traps only, never judge-wrong or cloze-wrong. Make 来/去 its own tile. Dropping 来/去 (他走进教室) is also correct.

subs.label: Thing objects: before or after 来/去
subs.focus: Place a thing object. 拿出一本书来 and 拿出来一本书 are both right: list both in alts, never make a cloze choose between them. Test forced cases: request or plan puts the object before 来/去 (带一本词典来吧); scrambled parts (拿来出一本书) are wrong. Classic mistake: scrambling the three parts.

subs.label: 把 + object + verb + direction
subs.focus: Build 把 + specific object + verb + direction (+ place) + 来/去, with 没/别/modals before 把 and 了 last. Classic mistakes: object after the complement (搬进来把椅子), bare verb (把椅子搬), 没 after 把, place after 来/去 (把行李拿上去楼). Good for 'Rewrite with 把.'

subs.label: 起来: start, or judging by (看起来)
subs.focus: Start: verb/adjective + 起来 (笑起来), object inside (下起雨来). Impression: 看/听/吃/穿/用 + 起来 + comment (看起来很累). Classic mistakes: 下雨起来, 看出来很累, bare 你看很累, 起来 where 下去 or 下来 is meant. Never use 看上去 as a wrong option: it is a correct synonym.

subs.label: 下去 keep going, 下来 settle or record
subs.focus: The learner must choose between 下去 (continue from now on: 说下去, 学下去, 这样下去), 下来 (come to rest or stay: 停下来, 安静下来, 留下来; fix on paper or in memory: 写下来, 记下来) and 起来 (start). Classic mistakes: 写下去 for 'write down', 停起来 for 'come to a stop', 说起来 for 'go on talking', and putting an object after 下去 (学下去汉语).

subs.label: 出来: figure out, recognise, produce
subs.focus: Use 出来 when something hidden becomes known (看出来, 听出来, 认出来) or something new is produced (想出来, 写出来, 做出来, 说出来). Classic mistakes: 想起来 (recall) for 想出来 (think up) and the reverse, 看起来 for 看出来. Context must show whether the thing was known before.

subs.label: 上 (attach, achieve) and 过来 / 过去
subs.focus: (1) Verb + 上, no 来/去: close or put on (关上, 穿上, 戴上, 写上), reach a goal (考上, 爱上). Mistakes: 穿起, 考到大学, 关上来. (2) 过来 across toward the speaker, 过去 away (走过来, 跑过去); 过来 also back to normal (醒过来, 改过来). Mistakes: the two swapped, 醒起来.

rules.rule: After 进, 出, 上, 下, 回, 过 add 来 if the movement ends nearer the speaker, 去 if it ends farther away. Ask: where am I standing?
rules.pattern: Subject + 进 / 出 / 上 / 下 / 回 / 过 + 来 / 去

examples.zh: 外面很冷，你快进来吧。
examples.py: wài miàn hěn lěng nǐ kuài jìn lái ba
examples.en: It's cold outside, come in quickly. (I am inside.)

examples.zh: 我在楼下等你，你下来吧。
examples.py: wǒ zài lóu xià děng nǐ nǐ xià lái ba
examples.en: I'm waiting for you downstairs, come down.

examples.zh: 他已经回去了，不在这儿。
examples.py: tā yǐ jīng huí qù le bú zài zhè r
examples.en: He has already gone back; he isn't here.

rules.note: When you are going to where the listener is, Chinese normally keeps your own viewpoint and says 去 (我马上过去), though 我马上过来 is also heard. English 'I'm coming' is not a safe guide.

rules.rule: To say how something moves and which way, stack three parts: the action verb, then the direction word, then 来 or 去. 起 only combines with 来: 起来 is rising from where you are, 坐下来 is sitting down.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 上 / 下 / 进 / 出 / 回 / 过 / 起 + 来 / 去

examples.zh: 老师走进来了。
examples.py: lǎo shī zǒu jìn lái le
examples.en: The teacher walked in.

examples.zh: 孩子们都跑出去了。
examples.py: hái zi men dōu pǎo chū qù le
examples.en: The children all ran out.

examples.zh: 请大家站起来。
examples.py: qǐng dà jiā zhàn qǐ lái
examples.en: Everyone, please stand up.

examples.zh: 你坐下来，我们慢慢说。
examples.py: nǐ zuò xià lái wǒ men màn màn shuō
examples.en: Sit down and let's talk it over slowly.

rules.note: There is no 起去. 起来 is upward with no destination (站起来, 拿起来); moving up to a higher place uses 上 (走上来, 跑上去).

rules.rule: In standard Mandarin a place does not follow 来 or 去. Put it right after the direction word and let 来/去 close the phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + (Verb) + direction + Place + 来 / 去

examples.zh: 他回家去了。
examples.py: tā huí jiā qù le
examples.en: He has gone home.

examples.zh: 老师走进教室来了。
examples.py: lǎo shī zǒu jìn jiào shì lái le
examples.en: The teacher walked into the classroom.

examples.zh: 下课以后，学生们都跑出教室去了。
examples.py: xià kè yǐ hòu xué sheng men dōu pǎo chū jiào shì qù le
examples.en: After class the students all ran out of the classroom.

examples.zh: 你什么时候回北京来？
examples.py: nǐ shén me shí hou huí běi jīng lái
examples.en: When are you coming back to Beijing?

rules.note: With a place, 来/去 is often simply left out (他走进教室, 他回家了). That is fine. Place after 来/去 (回来北京, 回去学校) is heard in casual speech, especially in the south; the form to produce is 回北京来 or simply 回北京.

rules.rule: An object that is a thing may go before 来/去 or after it. For a request or a plan (not done yet), put it before 来/去.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + (direction) + Object + 来 / 去, or Verb + (direction) + 来 / 去 + Object

examples.zh: 她从包里拿出一本书来。
examples.py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī běn shū lái
examples.en: She took a book out of her bag.

examples.zh: 她从包里拿出来一本书。
examples.py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái yī běn shū
examples.en: She took a book out of her bag.

examples.zh: 朋友给我带来了一些水果。
examples.py: péng you gěi wǒ dài lái le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ
examples.en: A friend brought me some fruit.

examples.zh: 你明天带一本词典来吧。
examples.py: nǐ míng tiān dài yī běn cí diǎn lái ba
examples.en: Bring a dictionary tomorrow.

rules.note: This is a tendency, not a hard rule: the object after 来/去 is most natural when the action has already happened and the object is 'a / some' something. If the object is a specific known thing, 把 is usually the best choice.

rules.rule: To move a specific thing somewhere, use 把: the object goes before the verb and the whole directional complement stays together after it. 没, 别 and modal verbs go before 把; 了 goes at the end.
rules.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + Verb + direction + (Place) + 来 / 去

examples.zh: 请把椅子搬进来。
examples.py: qǐng bǎ yǐ zi bān jìn lái
examples.en: Please carry the chairs in.

examples.zh: 他把手机从包里拿出来了。
examples.py: tā bǎ shǒu jī cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái le
examples.en: He took his phone out of his bag.

examples.zh: 我帮你把行李拿上楼去。
examples.py: wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ xíng li ná shàng lóu qù
examples.en: I'll help you take the luggage upstairs.

examples.zh: 别忘了把伞带回去。
examples.py: bié wàng le bǎ sǎn dài huí qù
examples.en: Don't forget to take the umbrella back with you.

rules.note: The place rule still holds inside a 把 sentence: 拿上楼去, not 拿上去楼.

rules.rule: Verb or adjective + 起来 means something starts and keeps going. If the verb has an object, the object goes between 起 and 来.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb / Adjective + 起来   or   Subject + Verb + 起 + Object + 来

examples.zh: 听了他的话，大家都笑起来了。
examples.py: tīng le tā de huà dà jiā dōu xiào qǐ lái le
examples.en: Hearing what he said, everyone started laughing.

examples.zh: 天气暖和起来了。
examples.py: tiān qì nuǎn huo qǐ lái le
examples.en: The weather is starting to get warm.

examples.zh: 外面突然下起雨来了。
examples.py: wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ yǔ lái le
examples.en: It suddenly started raining outside.

examples.zh: 他们一见面就聊起天来。
examples.py: tā men yī jiàn miàn jiù liáo qǐ tiān lái
examples.en: They start chatting the moment they meet.

rules.note: With adjectives, 起来 fits things that grow or get livelier (热, 多, 忙, 胖, 好). Getting quieter, slower or darker takes 下来 (安静下来, 慢下来).

rules.rule: 看 / 听 / 吃 / 穿 / 用 / 说 / 做 + 起来 + a comment gives your impression: 'it looks, sounds, tastes, feels ...' or 'when it comes to doing it ...'.
rules.pattern: Subject + 看 / 听 / 吃 / 穿 / 用 / 做 + 起来 + comment

examples.zh: 你看起来很累。
examples.py: nǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn lèi
examples.en: You look tired.

examples.zh: 这个办法听起来不错。
examples.py: zhè ge bàn fǎ tīng qǐ lái bú cuò
examples.en: This idea sounds good.

examples.zh: 这件衣服穿起来很舒服。
examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fu chuān qǐ lái hěn shū fu
examples.en: This piece of clothing is comfortable to wear.

examples.zh: 这件事说起来容易，做起来难。
examples.py: zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐ lái róng yì zuò qǐ lái nán
examples.en: This is easy to say but hard to do.

rules.note: 看上去 means the same as 看起来 for 'looks'. 看出来 is different: it means you managed to tell something by looking.

rules.rule: Verb + 下去 means carry on with something already under way. It takes no object after it.

examples.zh: 请你说下去，我们都在听。
examples.py: qǐng nǐ shuō xià qù wǒ men dōu zài tīng
examples.en: Please go on, we are all listening.

examples.zh: 汉语很难，可是我一定要学下去。
examples.py: hàn yǔ hěn nán kě shì wǒ yī dìng yào xué xià qù
examples.en: Chinese is hard, but I'm definitely going to keep studying it.

examples.zh: 再这样下去，你的身体会出问题。
examples.py: zài zhè yàng xià qù nǐ de shēn tǐ huì chū wèn tí
examples.en: If you go on like this, your health will suffer.

rules.note: 起来 is the start, 下去 is the continuation from now on. 坚持下去 is 'keep it up from here'; 坚持下来 is 'have kept it up until now'.

rules.rule: Verb + 下来 means something comes to rest or stays (stop, calm down, remain), or gets fixed so it will not be lost (write down, note down, remember).

examples.zh: 车在学校门口停下来了。
examples.py: chē zài xué xiào mén kǒu tíng xià lái le
examples.en: The car came to a stop at the school gate.

examples.zh: 教室里慢慢安静下来了。
examples.py: jiào shì lǐ màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
examples.en: The classroom slowly quietened down.

examples.zh: 请把你的电话号码写下来。
examples.py: qǐng bǎ nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ xiě xià lái
examples.en: Please write down your phone number.

examples.zh: 毕业以后，他决定留下来工作。
examples.py: bì yè yǐ hòu tā jué dìng liú xià lái gōng zuò
examples.en: After graduating he decided to stay on and work.

rules.rule: Verb + 出来 means something comes out into the open: you work out who or what it is (看, 听, 认), or you bring something new into being (想, 写, 做, 说).
rules.pattern: Subject + 看 / 听 / 认 / 想 / 写 / 做 / 说 + 出来 + (Object)

examples.zh: 我一听就听出来是你。
examples.py: wǒ yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái shì nǐ
examples.en: The moment I heard the voice I could tell it was you.

examples.zh: 他想出来一个好办法。
examples.py: tā xiǎng chū lái yī gè hǎo bàn fǎ
examples.en: He came up with a good idea.

examples.zh: 他变化很大，我没认出来。
examples.py: tā biàn huà hěn dà wǒ méi rèn chū lái
examples.en: He has changed a lot; I didn't recognise him.

examples.zh: 你心里有什么话就说出来吧。
examples.py: nǐ xīn lǐ yǒu shén me huà jiù shuō chū lái ba
examples.en: Whatever is on your mind, just say it.

rules.note: 想出来 is thinking up something that did not exist (an idea, a plan). 想起来 is recalling something you already knew (a name, a date).

rules.rule: Verb + 上 (no 来/去) means two things join or close (shut, put on, write on), or a goal is reached and a new state begins (get into university, fall in love).

examples.zh: 外面很冷，你穿上这件衣服吧。
examples.py: wài miàn hěn lěng nǐ chuān shàng zhè jiàn yī fu ba
examples.en: It's cold outside, put this on.

examples.zh: 请把门关上。
examples.py: qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng
examples.en: Please close the door.

examples.zh: 他今年考上了大学。
examples.py: tā jīn nián kǎo shàng le dà xué
examples.en: He got into university this year.

examples.zh: 她爱上了这个城市。
examples.py: tā ài shàng le zhè ge chéng shì
examples.en: She fell in love with this city.

rules.note: The opposite of putting on is 下 (脱下大衣), and opening takes 开 (打开门), not 上.

rules.rule: 过来 is across the space toward the speaker, 过去 is across it away from the speaker. 过来 also means coming back to a normal or correct state (wake up, put right).
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 过来 / 过去

examples.zh: 他看见我，就走过来了。
examples.py: tā kàn jiàn wǒ jiù zǒu guò lái le
examples.en: He saw me and walked over.

examples.zh: 你把那把椅子拿过来。
examples.py: nǐ bǎ nà bǎ yǐ zi ná guò lái
examples.en: Bring that chair over here.

examples.zh: 公共汽车来了，我们快跑过去吧。
examples.py: gōng gòng qì chē lái le wǒ men kuài pǎo guò qù ba
examples.en: The bus is here, let's run over to it.

examples.zh: 他睡了十个小时才醒过来。
examples.py: tā shuì le shí gè xiǎo shí cái xǐng guò lái
examples.en: He slept for ten hours before he woke up.

rules.note: The mirror image, 过去 for losing a normal state, exists too (to faint is 晕过去), but the words are above this level.

contrasts.why: In standard Mandarin a place does not follow 去. It goes between 回 and 去, or 去 is simply dropped (他回家了).

right.py: lǎo shī zǒu jìn jiào shì lái le
right.en: The teacher walked into the classroom.

contrasts.why: 教室 is a place, so the standard order puts it before 来, splitting 进 and 来. 走进来教室 is heard in casual speech but is not the form to produce.

right.py: wǒ zài lóu shàng nǐ kuài shàng lái ba

contrasts.why: The speaker is upstairs, so the movement is toward the speaker: 来, not 去.

right.py: wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ yǔ lái le

contrasts.why: With 起来 'start', the object 雨 goes between 起 and 来, never before 起来.

right.py: nǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn lèi

contrasts.why: An impression ('you look ...') is 看起来. 看出来 means to work something out by looking.

right.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái le tā jiào xiǎo wáng
right.en: Now I remember, his name is Xiao Wang.

contrasts.why: A name you knew and forgot is recalled, and the standard word for that is 想起来. 想出来 is for producing something new, like an idea (some speakers stretch it to recalling).

right.py: bié tíng qǐng nǐ shuō xià qù

contrasts.why: Carrying on with something already started is 下去. 起来 would be starting.

right.py: qǐng bǎ nǐ de míng zi xiě xià lái

contrasts.why: Fixing something on paper is 下来. 写下去 means 'keep on writing'.

right.py: chē màn màn tíng xià lái le
right.en: The car slowly came to a stop.

contrasts.why: Stopping, slowing and calming settle downward with 下来. 起来 is for things that start up, grow or liven up.

right.py: qǐng bǎ yǐ zi bān jìn lái

contrasts.why: 把 and its object go before the verb; verb + direction + 来 stays together at the end.

cheat: Where am I? Toward me 来, away from me 去.
Place word? It goes before 来/去: 回家去, 走进教室来, not 回去家 (standard usage).
Specific thing being moved? 把 + thing + verb + direction + 来/去.
起来 starts (object inside: 下起雨来) or gives an impression (看起来). 下去 keeps going.
下来: stop, calm down, stay, write down. 写下来, not 写下去.
出来: something new or hidden appears (想出来 think up, 听出来 recognise). 想起来 is remember.
上 with no 来/去: close it, put it on, make it (关上, 穿上, 考上).

items.zh: 这些药你要坚持吃下去。
items.py: zhè xiē yào nǐ yào jiān chí chī xià qù
items.en: You need to keep taking these medicines.
items.why: 吃下去 means carry on from now, and the object is fronted as a topic since 下去 takes no object after it: 吃下去这些药 is wrong.

items.q: 医生让他戴___口罩。
items.zh: 医生让他戴上口罩。
items.py: yī shēng ràng tā dài shàng kǒu zhào
items.en: The doctor told him to put on a mask.
items.why: Putting something on is 戴上. 戴过 would mean having worn one before, which does not fit an instruction.

items.q: 这份工作太累了，我真不想再这样干___了。
items.zh: 这份工作太累了，我真不想再这样干下去了。
items.py: zhè fèn gōng zuò tài lèi le wǒ zhēn bù xiǎng zài zhè yàng gàn xià qù le
items.en: This job is too tiring; I really don't want to carry on like this any more.
items.why: Carrying on from now is 干下去, and 再这样 sets up the 'if it continues' sense. 下来 would describe something already completed.

items.zh: 请把病历带来。
items.py: qǐng bǎ bìng lì dài lái
items.en: Please bring the medical record.
items.why: 把 and its object come before the verb, and 带来 stays together at the end. 带来把病历 puts the object after the complement.

items.q: 他变化太大了，我都没认___他来。
items.zh: 他变化太大了，我都没认出他来。
items.py: tā biàn huà tài dà le wǒ dōu méi rèn chū tā lái
items.en: He has changed so much that I didn't recognise him.
items.why: Recognising someone is 认出 (他) 来, with the person between 出 and 来. 认起, 认下 and 认上 are not used.

items.s: 我一定要学下去汉语。
items.s_py: wǒ yī dìng yào xué xià qù hàn yǔ
items.zh: 我一定要把汉语学下去。
items.py: wǒ yī dìng yào bǎ hàn yǔ xué xià qù
items.en: I'm definitely going to keep studying Chinese.
items.why: 下去 takes no object after it. Move the object in front of the verb (把汉语学下去) or the sentence breaks.

items.q: 检查做完了吗？做完了你就下___吧，我在一楼。
items.zh: 检查做完了吗？做完了你就下来吧，我在一楼。
items.py: jiǎn chá zuò wán le ma zuò wán le nǐ jiù xià lái ba wǒ zài yī lóu
items.en: Is the check-up finished? If so, come down; I'm on the ground floor.
items.why: I am waiting on the ground floor, so coming down ends near me: 下来. 下去 would send the listener away from where I stand.

items.q: 医生说的话，你最好都记___，回家再看。
items.zh: 医生说的话，你最好都记下来，回家再看。
items.py: yī shēng shuō de huà nǐ zuì hǎo dōu jì xià lái huí jiā zài kàn
items.en: You'd better note down everything the doctor says so you can read it at home.
items.why: Fixing words on paper is 记下来. 记起来 would mean you suddenly remember, which does not fit reading it at home later.

items.q: 这个新药看___很普通，可是特别有效。
items.zh: 这个新药看起来很普通，可是特别有效。
items.py: zhè ge xīn yào kàn qǐ lái hěn pǔ tōng kě shì tè bié yǒu xiào
items.en: This new medicine looks very ordinary, but it's especially effective.
items.why: An impression is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 means you worked something out, and it cannot be followed by a plain comment like 很普通.

items.q: 他没说名字，可是我一听就听___他是谁了。
items.zh: 他没说名字，可是我一听就听出来他是谁了。
items.py: tā méi shuō míng zi kě shì wǒ yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái tā shì shéi le
items.en: He didn't give his name, but I could tell who he was as soon as I heard him.
items.why: Identifying something hidden by listening is 听出来. 听起来 gives an impression ('it sounds like') and cannot take a clause like 他是谁.

items.src: 我一听声音，就知道是李医生。
items.src_py: wǒ yī tīng shēng yīn jiù zhī dào shì lǐ yī shēng
items.task: Say you could tell by listening (use 听出来).
items.zh: 我一听就听出来是李医生。
items.py: wǒ yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái shì lǐ yī shēng
items.en: The moment I listened I could tell it was Dr Li.
items.why: Working out who it is by listening is 听出来. 听起来 would mean 'it sounds like' and does not fit 一听就.

items.zh: 他把窗户关上了。
items.py: tā bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng le
items.en: He closed the window.
items.why: 把 puts the window before the verb, 关上 keeps its complement and 了 comes last. 关上来 would add a direction that does not fit.

items.s: 医生从包里拿出来一支笔。
items.s_py: yī shēng cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái yī zhī bǐ
items.zh: 医生从包里拿出来一支笔。
items.py: yī shēng cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái yī zhī bǐ
items.en: The doctor took a pen out of his bag.
items.why: A thing object may follow 来 when the action has happened: 拿出来一支笔 is as good as 拿出一支笔来.

items.q: 你到了就直接上___吧，我在这儿三楼办公室等你。
items.zh: 你到了就直接上来吧，我在这儿三楼办公室等你。
items.py: nǐ dào le jiù zhí jiē shàng lái ba wǒ zài zhè r sān lóu bàn gōng shì děng nǐ
items.en: When you arrive, just come straight up; I'm waiting here in the third-floor office.
items.why: I am waiting here upstairs, so going up ends where I am: 上来. 上去 would be said from below or from the listener's point of view, and 这儿 rules that out.

items.q: 孩子打了针以后，慢慢安静___了。
items.zh: 孩子打了针以后，慢慢安静下来了。
items.py: hái zi dǎ le zhēn yǐ hòu màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
items.en: After the injection the child slowly calmed down.
items.why: Calming down is a settling change, so 下来: 安静下来. 下去 would mean staying quiet from now on, and 上去 sends something upward.

items.s: 经理一进来，大家就安静上来了。
items.s_py: jīng lǐ yī jìn lái dà jiā jiù ān jìng shàng lái le
items.zh: 经理一进来，大家就安静下来了。
items.py: jīng lǐ yī jìn lái dà jiā jiù ān jìng xià lái le
items.en: The moment the manager came in, everyone quietened down.
items.why: Going quiet settles downward: 安静下来. 上来 means coming up and cannot describe becoming quiet.

items.q: 我在一楼大厅，经理从三楼走下___了。
items.zh: 我在一楼大厅，经理从三楼走下楼来了。
items.py: wǒ zài yī lóu dà tīng jīng lǐ cóng sān lóu zǒu xià lóu lái le
items.en: I'm in the ground-floor hall; the manager has come down from the third floor.
items.why: 走下楼来: the place 楼 sits between 下 and 来. I am downstairs, so toward me is 来, and 来楼 or 去楼 would put the place after the direction.

items.s: 他从大楼里走出来，坐上了出租车。
items.s_py: tā cóng dà lóu lǐ zǒu chū lái zuò shàng le chū zū chē
items.zh: 他从大楼里走出来，坐上了出租车。
items.py: tā cóng dà lóu lǐ zǒu chū lái zuò shàng le chū zū chē
items.en: He walked out of the building and got into a taxi.
items.why: 坐上 is getting into a vehicle, with 了 after 上 and no 来/去. 走出来 shows the first movement out of the building.

items.q: 手机掉在地上了，请帮我捡___来。
items.zh: 手机掉在地上了，请帮我捡起来。
items.py: shǒu jī diào zài dì shàng le qǐng bāng wǒ jiǎn qǐ lái
items.en: My phone dropped on the floor; please pick it up for me.
items.why: Lifting something off the floor is 捡起来. 上 would mean bringing it up from a lower level, and 下 and 进 point the wrong way.

items.src_py: wǒ dài lái le nà fèn zī liào
items.zh: 我把那份资料带来了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà fèn zī liào dài lái le
items.en: I brought that file.
items.why: A specific object (那份资料) fits 把: it goes before the verb and 带来 plus 了 stay at the end.

items.q: 医生说他的病不重，可以留___观察一天。
items.zh: 医生说他的病不重，可以留下来观察一天。
items.py: yī shēng shuō tā de bìng bú zhòng kě yǐ liú xià lái guān chá yī tiān
items.en: The doctor said his illness isn't serious and he can stay for a day of observation.
items.why: Staying put is 留下来. 起来 would mean something starts, and 留出来 would mean setting something aside.

items.src_py: tā huí jiā le
items.task: Add 去 to say he has gone home.
items.zh: 他回家去了。
items.py: tā huí jiā qù le
items.en: He has gone home.
items.why: The place 家 sits before 去 and 了 closes the sentence. 回去家 puts the place after 去.

items.q: 你可以把这份表格从网上___吗？
items.zh: 你可以把这份表格从网上下载下来吗？
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ zhè fèn biǎo gé cóng wǎng shàng xià zǎi xià lái ma
items.en: Can you download this form from the internet?
items.why: Saving something to your own device is 下载下来: it comes to rest with you. 起来 would mean starting to download and 下去 continuing.

items.s: 我想了很久，才想起来他的名字。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ cái xiǎng qǐ lái tā de míng zi
items.zh: 我想了很久，才想起来他的名字。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ cái xiǎng qǐ lái tā de míng zi
items.en: I thought for a long time before I remembered his name.
items.why: A name you once knew is recalled with 想起来, with the object after 来. 想出来 is for inventing something new.

items.s: 听到这个好消息，他高兴得跳起了。
items.s_py: tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xi tā gāo xìng de tiào qǐ le
items.zh: 听到这个好消息，他高兴得跳起来了。
items.py: tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xi tā gāo xìng de tiào qǐ lái le
items.en: Hearing the good news, he jumped up with joy.
items.why: 起 needs 来 to complete it: 跳起来. Leaving 来 out and ending with 起了 is incomplete.

items.q: 你把那把椅子拿___，我想坐一会儿。
items.zh: 你把那把椅子拿过来，我想坐一会儿。
items.py: nǐ bǎ nà bǎ yǐ zi ná guò lái wǒ xiǎng zuò yī huì r
items.en: Bring that chair over here; I'd like to sit for a while.
items.why: Bringing something across to the speaker is 拿过来. 拿起来 only lifts it, and 拿下去 or 拿出去 carry it away from me.

items.zh: 同事从楼上跑下来了。
items.py: tóng shì cóng lóu shàng pǎo xià lái le
items.en: My colleague has run down from upstairs.
items.why: From a higher floor to the speaker below is 下来, kept together after the verb: 跑下来. 跑来下 reverses the parts.

items.s: 天冷，你把外套穿起吧。
items.s_py: tiān lěng nǐ bǎ wài tào chuān qǐ ba
items.zh: 天冷，你把外套穿上吧。
items.py: tiān lěng nǐ bǎ wài tào chuān shàng ba
items.en: It's cold, put your coat on.
items.why: Putting on clothes is 穿上. 起 only appears with 来 (穿起来) and cannot end the verb alone.

items.q: 听了经理的话，大家都笑___了。
items.zh: 听了经理的话，大家都笑起来了。
items.py: tīng le jīng lǐ de huà dà jiā dōu xiào qǐ lái le
items.en: Hearing the manager's words, everyone started to laugh.
items.why: Verb + 起来 marks the start of an action: 笑起来. 下去 would be carrying on, and 下来 means settling down.

items.q: 我现在在医院，医生要看病历，可我没把病历带___。
items.zh: 我现在在医院，医生要看病历，可我没把病历带来。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài zài yī yuàn yī shēng yào kàn bìng lì kě wǒ méi bǎ bìng lì dài lái
items.en: I'm at the hospital and the doctor wants to see my record, but I didn't bring it.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and the verb keeps its direction: 带来. The record should have come to where I am now, so 来, not 去.

items.s: 你的脸色看出来很不好。
items.s_py: nǐ de liǎn sè kàn chū lái hěn bù hǎo
items.zh: 你的脸色看起来很不好。
items.py: nǐ de liǎn sè kàn qǐ lái hěn bù hǎo
items.en: Your complexion looks very bad.
items.why: An impression followed by a comment is 看起来. 看出来 means you worked something out, so the comment 很不好 cannot follow it.

items.q: 你天天熬夜，再这样___，身体会出问题的。
items.zh: 你天天熬夜，再这样下去，身体会出问题的。
items.py: nǐ tiān tiān áo yè zài zhè yàng xià qù shēn tǐ huì chū wèn tí de
items.en: You stay up late every day; if this goes on, your health will suffer.
items.why: 再这样下去 is the fixed phrase for 'if it carries on like this': 下去 continues from now on. 下来 looks back at something finished.

items.s: 听到这个消息，他慢慢冷静下来了。
items.s_py: tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xi tā màn màn lěng jìng xià lái le
items.zh: 听到这个消息，他慢慢冷静下来了。
items.py: tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xi tā màn màn lěng jìng xià lái le
items.en: Hearing the news, he gradually calmed down.
items.why: Calming down is a settling change, so 下来. 冷静起来 would sound like becoming cool-headed from nothing.

items.src_py: bìng rén màn màn ān jìng le
items.task: Say he settled down (use 下来).
items.zh: 病人慢慢安静下来了。
items.py: bìng rén màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
items.en: The patient gradually quietened down.
items.why: Calming down settles downward: 安静下来. 安静起来 would sound like something starting up.

items.src_py: hù shi bǎ shuǐ duān guò lái le
items.task: Turn it into a polite request.
items.zh: 请你把水端过来。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ shuǐ duān guò lái
items.en: Please bring the water over.
items.why: A request keeps the 把 structure with 请 in front, and 了 is dropped because nothing has happened yet.

items.src_py: tā ná chū bìng lì lái le
items.zh: 他把病历拿出来了。
items.py: tā bǎ bìng lì ná chū lái le
items.en: He took out the medical record.
items.why: 把 moves 病历 before the verb, and 拿出来 stays together with 了 last. The 来 no longer has to split the verb from its object.

items.q: 同事从北京给我带___一些药。
items.zh: 同事从北京给我带来了一些药。
items.py: tóng shì cóng běi jīng gěi wǒ dài lái le yī xiē yào
items.en: A colleague brought me some medicine from Beijing.
items.why: 来 follows the verb directly and 了 comes after it: 带来了一些药. 带了来 reverses them, and 去 points away from me although the medicine came to me.

items.q: 他把写错的字改___了。
items.zh: 他把写错的字改过来了。
items.py: tā bǎ xiě cuò de zì gǎi guò lái le
items.en: He corrected the characters he'd written wrongly.
items.why: Putting something right is 改过来: 过来 also means back to the correct state. 改起来 would mean starting to change it.

items.q: 请你把办公室的门关___。
items.zh: 请你把办公室的门关上。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ bàn gōng shì de mén guān shàng
items.en: Please close the office door.
items.why: Shutting something is 关上: 上 means two things come together. 关出, 关进 and 关过 do not mean closing a door.

items.s: 护士把病人从床上扶起来了。
items.s_py: hù shi bǎ bìng rén cóng chuáng shàng fú qǐ lái le
items.zh: 护士把病人从床上扶起来了。
items.py: hù shi bǎ bìng rén cóng chuáng shàng fú qǐ lái le
items.en: The nurse helped the patient up from the bed.
items.why: 把 puts the patient before the verb, and 起来 stays attached to 扶 at the end: raising someone up from lying.

items.zh: 他把体检报告拿上楼去了。
items.py: tā bǎ tǐ jiǎn bào gào ná shàng lóu qù le
items.en: He took the check-up report upstairs.
items.why: In a 把 sentence the place still goes between 上 and 去: 拿上楼去了. 拿上去楼 puts it after 去.

items.q: 病人在三楼病房，我是一楼的护士，我现在就上___看他。
items.zh: 病人在三楼病房，我是一楼的护士，我现在就上去看他。
items.py: bìng rén zài sān lóu bìng fáng wǒ shì yī lóu de hù shi wǒ xiàn zài jiù shàng qù kàn tā
items.en: The patient is in the third-floor ward and I'm a nurse on the ground floor, so I'm going up to see him now.
items.why: I am on the ground floor and the ward is above, so I move away from my own spot: 上去. 上来 needs the speaker to be upstairs.

items.q: 你累了就先停___，休息一下再走。
items.zh: 你累了就先停下来，休息一下再走。
items.py: nǐ lèi le jiù xiān tíng xià lái xiū xi yī xià zài zǒu
items.en: If you're tired, stop for a moment and rest before going on.
items.why: Coming to a halt is 停下来. 下去 means continuing, which contradicts resting, and 起来 means starting.

items.s: 外面突然下雨起来了。
items.s_py: wài miàn tū rán xià yǔ qǐ lái le
items.zh: 外面突然下起雨来了。
items.py: wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ yǔ lái le
items.en: It suddenly started raining outside.
items.why: With 起来 'start' the object goes inside: 下起雨来. Putting 雨 before 起来 is the classic mistake.

items.q: 他考___了医科大学，想当医生。
items.zh: 他考上了医科大学，想当医生。
items.py: tā kǎo shàng le yī kē dà xué xiǎng dāng yī shēng
items.en: He got into medical university and wants to be a doctor.
items.why: Reaching a goal such as a place at university is 考上. 考出 and 考起 do not carry that meaning, and 考下 is not used for exams.

items.q: 护士说，病人睡了一整天才醒___。
items.zh: 护士说，病人睡了一整天才醒过来。
items.py: hù shi shuō bìng rén shuì le yī zhěng tiān cái xǐng guò lái
items.en: The nurse said the patient slept a whole day before waking up.
items.why: Coming back to consciousness is 醒过来: 过来 means returning to a normal state. 醒起来 is not a word.

items.q: 运动以后，他的心跳快___了。
items.zh: 运动以后，他的心跳快起来了。
items.py: yùn dòng yǐ hòu tā de xīn tiào kuài qǐ lái le
items.en: After exercising, his heartbeat started to speed up.
items.why: Speeding up is something that picks up: 快起来. 下来 is for slowing or settling down, which is the opposite of 快.

items.zh: 他走进办公室来了。
items.py: tā zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì lái le
items.en: He has walked into the office.
items.why: The place 办公室 sits between 走进 and 来, and 来 closes the phrase. 走进来办公室 puts the place after 来, which is wrong.

items.s: 他走进办公室了。
items.s_py: tā zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì le
items.zh: 他走进办公室了。
items.py: tā zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì le
items.en: He walked into the office.
items.why: With a place object 来/去 is optional, so 走进办公室 is complete. The real mistake would be 走进来办公室, not leaving 来 out.

items.q: 我在办公室等你，你把体检报告拿___吧。
items.zh: 我在办公室等你，你把体检报告拿进来吧。
items.py: wǒ zài bàn gōng shì děng nǐ nǐ bǎ tǐ jiǎn bào gào ná jìn lái ba
items.en: I'm waiting in the office; bring the check-up report in.
items.why: 把 + thing + verb + direction + 来/去. The report comes into the office where I am, so 进来. 出去, 上去 and 下去 all send it away.

items.s: 我把手机没带来。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ shǒu jī méi dài lái
items.zh: 我没把手机带来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ shǒu jī dài lái
items.en: I didn't bring my phone.
items.why: 没 must go before 把, never between 把 and the verb.

items.s: 他从三楼走来下了。
items.s_py: tā cóng sān lóu zǒu lái xià le
items.zh: 他从三楼走下来了。
items.py: tā cóng sān lóu zǒu xià lái le
items.en: He walked down from the third floor.
items.why: The order is verb + direction + 来: 走下来. 来 can never come before the direction word 下.

items.q: 我在楼下，经理在楼上叫你，你快上___吧。
items.zh: 我在楼下，经理在楼上叫你，你快上去吧。
items.py: wǒ zài lóu xià jīng lǐ zài lóu shàng jiào nǐ nǐ kuài shàng qù ba
items.en: I'm downstairs and the manager is upstairs asking for you, so go up quickly.
items.why: I stay downstairs and the listener goes up to the manager, away from me: 上去. 上来 would need the speaker to be at the top.

items.q: 外面下___雨来了，我们快回办公室吧。
items.zh: 外面下起雨来了，我们快回办公室吧。
items.py: wài miàn xià qǐ yǔ lái le wǒ men kuài huí bàn gōng shì ba
items.en: It's started raining outside; let's get back to the office quickly.
items.why: With 起来 'start', the object goes inside: 下起雨来. 下上雨来 and 下出雨来 do not exist.

items.zh: 同事向我走过来了。
items.py: tóng shì xiàng wǒ zǒu guò lái le
items.en: My colleague has walked over towards me.
items.why: 过来 is across the space toward the speaker, and 向我 comes before the verb. 走来过 reverses the complement.

items.src_py: hái zi kū le
items.zh: 孩子哭起来了。
items.py: hái zi kū qǐ lái le
items.en: The child started crying.
items.why: Verb + 起来 shows an action starting, with 了 at the end for the new situation.

items.q: 药店在马路对面，我现在走___买药。
items.zh: 药店在马路对面，我现在走过去买药。
items.py: yào diàn zài mǎ lù duì miàn wǒ xiàn zài zǒu guò qù mǎi yào
items.en: The pharmacy is across the road; I'm going over now to buy medicine.
items.why: The pharmacy is on the far side from me, so crossing is away from me: 过去. 过来 would be coming toward me, and 起来 or 下来 do not cross anything.

items.q: 吃了药以后，他的病慢慢好___了。
items.zh: 吃了药以后，他的病慢慢好起来了。
items.py: chī le yào yǐ hòu tā de bìng màn màn hǎo qǐ lái le
items.en: After taking the medicine, he slowly started to get better.
items.why: Something beginning to improve is 好起来: 起来 fits things that pick up. 下来 is for settling or slowing down, the opposite direction.

items.q: 我们都在三楼这儿等你，你快上___吧。
items.zh: 我们都在三楼这儿等你，你快上楼来吧。
items.py: wǒ men dōu zài sān lóu zhè r děng nǐ nǐ kuài shàng lóu lái ba
items.en: We're all waiting for you here on the third floor; come up quickly.
items.why: The speaker is upstairs, so the movement is toward us: 上楼来, with the place 楼 before 来. 上来楼 puts the place after 来, and 上楼去 would point away from the speaker.

items.zh: 经理让同事把资料送进会议室去。
items.py: jīng lǐ ràng tóng shì bǎ zī liào sòng jìn huì yì shì qù
items.en: The manager asked a colleague to take the files into the meeting room.
items.why: The 把 phrase sits before 送进, and the place 会议室 comes before 去: 送进会议室去. 送进去会议室 is wrong.

items.q: 我在医院等你，明天请带一本病历___吧。
items.zh: 我在医院等你，明天请带一本病历来吧。
items.py: wǒ zài yī yuàn děng nǐ míng tiān qǐng dài yī běn bìng lì lái ba
items.en: I'll be waiting at the hospital; please bring a medical record tomorrow.
items.why: A request puts the thing before the direction: 带一本病历来. I am at the hospital, so toward me is 来, not 去.

items.q: 你看___他今天不太舒服吗？
items.zh: 你看出来他今天不太舒服吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn chū lái tā jīn tiān bú tài shū fu ma
items.en: Can you tell he isn't feeling very well today?
items.why: Noticing something by looking is 看出来. 看起来 would be an impression and cannot follow 你 with a clause like this.

items.s: 你快站起去，经理来了。
items.s_py: nǐ kuài zhàn qǐ qù jīng lǐ lái le
items.zh: 你快站起来，经理来了。
items.py: nǐ kuài zhàn qǐ lái jīng lǐ lái le
items.en: Stand up quickly, the manager is here.
items.why: 起 only combines with 来, so 'stand up' is 站起来. 起去 does not exist.

items.q: 我站在走廊里，看着她推开门，走进___了。
items.zh: 我站在走廊里，看着她推开门，走进诊室去了。
items.py: wǒ zhàn zài zǒu láng lǐ kàn zhe tā tuī kāi mén zǒu jìn zhěn shì qù le
items.en: Standing in the corridor, I watched her push the door open and go into the consulting room.
items.why: I stay in the corridor and she goes in, away from me: 走进诊室去. The place sits before 去, and 来 would need me to be inside the room.

items.q: 他被针扎了一下，疼得从椅子上跳___来。
items.zh: 他被针扎了一下，疼得从椅子上跳起来。
items.py: tā bèi zhēn zhā le yī xià téng de cóng yǐ zi shàng tiào qǐ lái
items.en: He was jabbed by the needle and jumped up from the chair in pain.
items.why: Jumping up on the spot is 跳起来. 跳上来 means jumping up onto something, and 跳下来 would be jumping down.

items.q: 经理一说话，吵闹的会议室一下子就静___了。
items.zh: 经理一说话，吵闹的会议室一下子就静下来了。
items.py: jīng lǐ yī shuō huà chǎo nào de huì yì shì yī xià zi jiù jìng xià lái le
items.en: The moment the manager spoke, the noisy meeting room fell quiet.
items.why: Noise dying away is a settling change: 静下来. 静起来 is not used for going quiet, and 下去 would mean it stays quiet from now on.

items.zh: 输液结束后他慢慢坐起来了。
items.py: shū yè jié shù hòu tā màn màn zuò qǐ lái le
items.en: After the drip finished, he slowly sat up.
items.why: Sitting up from lying down is 坐起来. 坐下来 means sitting down from standing, and the adverb 慢慢 stays before the verb.

items.zh: 这个办法是他想出来的。
items.py: zhè ge bàn fǎ shì tā xiǎng chū lái de
items.en: He is the one who came up with this idea.
items.why: 想出来 is thinking up something new, in the 是……的 frame. 想起来 would be remembering something already known.

items.zh: 窗外下起雨来了。
items.py: chuāng wài xià qǐ yǔ lái le
items.en: It has started to rain outside the window.
items.why: With 起来 'start', the object 雨 goes inside it: 下起雨来. 下雨起来 leaves the object outside.

items.zh: 她考上了北京大学。
items.py: tā kǎo shàng le běi jīng dà xué
items.en: She got into Peking University.
items.why: Reaching a goal is verb + 上, with 了 after it and no 来/去: 考上了北京大学. 考起 does not exist in this sense.

items.s: 你得把症状写下去，医生要看。
items.s_py: nǐ děi bǎ zhèng zhuàng xiě xià qù yī shēng yào kàn
items.zh: 你得把症状写下来，医生要看。
items.py: nǐ děi bǎ zhèng zhuàng xiě xià lái yī shēng yào kàn
items.en: You have to write your symptoms down; the doctor wants to see them.
items.why: Fixing something on paper is 写下来. 写下去 means to keep on writing.

items.q: 办公室里只剩我一个人，同事们都跑出___吃午饭了。
items.zh: 办公室里只剩我一个人，同事们都跑出办公室去吃午饭了。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ zhǐ shèng wǒ yī gè rén tóng shì men dōu pǎo chū bàn gōng shì qù chī wǔ fàn le
items.en: Only I am left in the office; my colleagues have all run out to lunch.
items.why: The place goes before 去: 跑出办公室去. They leave away from me, so 去, not 来, and the place cannot follow 去.

items.zh: 车在医院门口停下来了。
items.py: chē zài yī yuàn mén kǒu tíng xià lái le
items.en: The car stopped at the hospital gate.
items.why: 停下来 is a coming to rest, and the 在 phrase comes before the verb. 停下去 would mean to keep stopping, which makes no sense.

items.s: 你看起来有点儿累，是不是没睡好？
items.s_py: nǐ kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r lèi shì bú shì méi shuì hǎo
items.zh: 你看起来有点儿累，是不是没睡好？
items.py: nǐ kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r lèi shì bú shì méi shuì hǎo
items.en: You look a bit tired; didn't you sleep well?
items.why: An impression is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 would mean you had worked something out.

items.q: 这个新办法是我们团队花了三个月才想___的。
items.zh: 这个新办法是我们团队花了三个月才想出来的。
items.py: zhè ge xīn bàn fǎ shì wǒ men tuán duì huā le sān gè yuè cái xiǎng chū lái de
items.en: This new method is something our team spent three months coming up with.
items.why: Creating something that did not exist is 想出来. 想起来 is recalling what you already knew, and the method was only just made.

items.q: 这件白大褂穿___有点儿大。
items.zh: 这件白大褂穿起来有点儿大。
items.py: zhè jiàn bái dà guà chuān qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r dà
items.en: This white coat is a bit big when you wear it.
items.why: How something feels in use is verb + 起来 + comment: 穿起来有点儿大. The other endings do not introduce a judgement.

items.s: 我在一楼，你下来吧，我们一起去吃饭。
items.s_py: wǒ zài yī lóu nǐ xià lái ba wǒ men yī qǐ qù chī fàn
items.zh: 我在一楼，你下来吧，我们一起去吃饭。
items.py: wǒ zài yī lóu nǐ xià lái ba wǒ men yī qǐ qù chī fàn
items.en: I'm on the ground floor, so come down and let's go and eat together.
items.why: The speaker is downstairs, so 下来 is right. The 去 in 去吃饭 is a separate verb 'go', not a direction word.

items.q: 天冷了，出门要穿___厚外套。
items.zh: 天冷了，出门要穿上厚外套。
items.py: tiān lěng le chū mén yào chuān shàng hòu wài tào
items.en: It's getting cold; put on a thick coat when you go out.
items.why: Putting a garment on is 穿上 with no 来/去. 穿下 does not exist and 穿起 only occurs in 穿起来.

items.s: 天冷了，你多穿上一件衣服吧。
items.s_py: tiān lěng le nǐ duō chuān shàng yī jiàn yī fu ba
items.zh: 天冷了，你多穿上一件衣服吧。
items.py: tiān lěng le nǐ duō chuān shàng yī jiàn yī fu ba
items.en: It's getting cold; put on another layer.
items.why: 穿上 'put on' takes no 来/去 and can have a counted object right after it.

items.s: 医生从包里拿来出一支笔。
items.s_py: yī shēng cóng bāo lǐ ná lái chū yī zhī bǐ
items.zh: 医生从包里拿出一支笔来。
items.py: yī shēng cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhī bǐ lái
items.en: The doctor took a pen out of his bag.
items.why: The direction word comes right after the verb and 来 follows it: 拿出, then 来. Putting 来 before 出 scrambles the parts.

items.q: 经理正从马路对面走___来。
items.zh: 经理正从马路对面走过来。
items.py: jīng lǐ zhèng cóng mǎ lù duì miàn zǒu guò lái
items.en: The manager is walking over from the other side of the road.
items.why: Crossing from the opposite side is 过: 走过来. 起 only means rising, and 上 or 下 need a higher or lower place.

items.q: 王医生不在医院，他已经回___了。
items.zh: 王医生不在医院，他已经回去了。
items.py: wáng yī shēng bú zài yī yuàn tā yǐ jīng huí qù le
items.en: Dr Wang isn't at the hospital; he has already gone back.
items.why: He is no longer where I am, so the movement was away from here: 回去. 回来 would mean he is back at this hospital.

items.src_py: tā chuān le bái dà guà
items.task: Say she put it on (use 上).
items.zh: 她穿上了白大褂。
items.py: tā chuān shàng le bái dà guà
items.en: She put on the white coat.
items.why: Putting on clothing is 穿上, with 了 after it and no 来/去.

items.q: 这份报告是小王一个人写___的，没有别人帮忙。
items.zh: 这份报告是小王一个人写出来的，没有别人帮忙。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào shì xiǎo wáng yī gè rén xiě chū lái de méi yǒu bié rén bāng máng
items.en: Xiao Wang produced this report all by himself, with no help from anyone.
items.why: Bringing a piece of work into being is 写出来. 写下来 means putting something already known on paper, and 起来 would mean starting.

items.q: 护士推着病人从电梯里走___来了。
items.zh: 护士推着病人从电梯里走出来了。
items.py: hù shi tuī zhe bìng rén cóng diàn tī lǐ zǒu chū lái le
items.en: The nurse came out of the lift pushing the patient.
items.why: Leaving a lift (a container) is 出: 走出来. 走进来 would mean walking into it, and 从电梯里 shows the starting point is inside.

items.zh: 开会时我把重点记下来了。
items.py: kāi huì shí wǒ bǎ zhòng diǎn jì xià lái le
items.en: I wrote down the key points during the meeting.
items.why: Fixing something on paper is 记下来, kept together after 把重点. 记下去 would mean to keep on noting.

items.q: 她从抽屉里拿___。
items.zh: 她从抽屉里拿出一份文件来。
items.py: tā cóng chōu ti lǐ ná chū yī fèn wén jiàn lái
items.en: She took a document out of the drawer.
items.why: A thing object sits between 出 and 来 (拿出一份文件来). The three parts verb, direction and 来 cannot be scrambled around the object.

items.q: 我已经在会议室里了，你快进___吧。
items.zh: 我已经在会议室里了，你快进来吧。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng zài huì yì shì lǐ le nǐ kuài jìn lái ba
items.en: I'm already in the meeting room, so come in quickly.
items.why: I am inside, so entering moves toward me: 进来. 进去 would suit someone standing outside and watching the listener go in.

items.q: 他不在公司了，已经回___了。
items.zh: 他不在公司了，已经回家去了。
items.py: tā bú zài gōng sī le yǐ jīng huí jiā qù le
items.en: He's no longer at the company; he has already gone home.
items.why: A place sits between the direction word and 去: 回家去. 回去家 and 回来家 put it after 来/去, and 家来 points toward the speaker at the company.

items.q: 老板一进办公室，大家都站___来了。
items.zh: 老板一进办公室，大家都站起来了。
items.py: lǎo bǎn yī jìn bàn gōng shì dà jiā dōu zhàn qǐ lái le
items.en: As soon as the boss walked into the office, everyone stood up.
items.why: Rising from a seat is 站起来: 起 pairs with 来 for rising on the spot. 站上来 would mean stepping up onto something.

items.src_py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō wǒ men dōu zài tīng
items.zh: 请你说下去，我们都在听。
items.py: qǐng nǐ shuō xià qù wǒ men dōu zài tīng
items.en: Please go on, we are all listening.
items.why: Carrying on with something already under way is 说下去. 说起来 would be starting, and 下去 takes no object.

items.q: 我刚才在路上突然想___来，今天是他的生日。
items.zh: 我刚才在路上突然想起来，今天是他的生日。
items.py: wǒ gāng cái zài lù shàng tū rán xiǎng qǐ lái jīn tiān shì tā de shēng rì
items.en: Just now on the road I suddenly remembered that today is his birthday.
items.why: Something you knew and had forgotten comes back with 想起来, and it can take a clause. 想出来 means thinking up an idea or working out an answer, which does not fit a birthday you already knew.

items.q: 我躺在病房里，医生走进___了。
items.zh: 我躺在病房里，医生走进病房来了。
items.py: wǒ tǎng zài bìng fáng lǐ yī shēng zǒu jìn bìng fáng lái le
items.en: I was lying in the ward when the doctor walked in.
items.why: 病房 must sit before 来, and the doctor comes toward me in the ward, so 来. 走进来病房 puts the place after 来, and 去 points away from me.

items.q: 护士给我端___。
items.zh: 护士给我端来一杯热水。
items.py: hù shi gěi wǒ duān lái yī bēi rè shuǐ
items.en: The nurse brought me a cup of hot water.
items.why: After the verb 端 comes 来 and then the new object: 端来一杯热水. The measure phrase stays attached to 热水 and cannot be split from it.

items.zh: 护士拿出一片药来。
items.py: hù shi ná chū yī piàn yào lái
items.en: The nurse took out a tablet.
items.why: A thing object may go before or after 来, so both 拿出一片药来 and 拿出来一片药 are right. 来 cannot go before 出.

items.q: 老板把客人带___了。
items.zh: 老板把客人带进会议室去了。
items.py: lǎo bǎn bǎ kè rén dài jìn huì yì shì qù le
items.en: The boss took the guests into the meeting room.
items.why: With a place, 去 closes the phrase: 带进会议室去. 带进去会议室 puts the place after 去, and the other options scramble the order.

items.q: 他从包里拿___一份文件来。
items.zh: 他从包里拿出一份文件来。
items.py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī fèn wén jiàn lái
items.en: He took a document out of his bag.
items.why: Something coming out of a bag is 出. 进, 上 and 回 do not describe leaving a container.

items.q: 电脑在一楼，同事帮我把它搬___三楼去了。
items.zh: 电脑在一楼，同事帮我把它搬上三楼去了。
items.py: diàn nǎo zài yī lóu tóng shì bāng wǒ bǎ tā bān shàng sān lóu qù le
items.en: The computer was on the ground floor, and a colleague helped me carry it up to the third floor.
items.why: From the ground floor to the third floor is upward: 上. The place 三楼 sits between 上 and 去 even inside a 把 sentence.

items.q: 你站了一上午了，快坐___来休息一下。
items.zh: 你站了一上午了，快坐下来休息一下。
items.py: nǐ zhàn le yī shàng wǔ le kuài zuò xià lái xiū xi yī xià
items.en: You've been on your feet all morning, so sit down and rest a bit.
items.why: Going from standing to sitting is 坐下来. 坐起来 means sitting up from lying down, which does not fit someone who has been standing.

items.q: 我在商店里面，你快进___吧。
items.zh: 我在商店里面，你快进来吧。
items.py: wǒ zài shāng diàn lǐ miàn nǐ kuài jìn lái ba
items.en: I'm inside the shop, come in quickly.
items.why: The speaker is already inside, so the movement ends where the speaker is: 进来. 进去 would fit only if the speaker stood outside the shop.

items.q: 我在楼上等你，你怎么还不上___？
items.zh: 我在楼上等你，你怎么还不上来？
items.py: wǒ zài lóu shàng děng nǐ nǐ zěn me hái bù shàng lái
items.en: I'm waiting upstairs. Why haven't you come up yet?
items.why: The speaker is upstairs, so going up means moving toward the speaker: 上来. English 'go up' tempts learners into 上去.

items.q: 我现在在商场，钱包忘在家里了，得马上回___拿。
items.zh: 我现在在商场，钱包忘在家里了，得马上回去拿。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài zài shāng chǎng qián bāo wàng zài jiā lǐ le děi mǎ shàng huí qù ná
items.en: I'm at the mall now and I left my wallet at home, so I have to go back for it right away.
items.why: The speaker is at the mall and home is somewhere else, so going back moves away from the speaker: 回去. 回来 would mean heading to where the speaker is.

items.q: 我在场外看球，球员们都跑进___了。
items.zh: 我在场外看球，球员们都跑进去了。
items.py: wǒ zài chǎng wài kàn qiú qiú yuán men dōu pǎo jìn qù le
items.en: I'm watching from outside the pitch, and the players have all run in.
items.why: The speaker stands outside, so running into the pitch moves away from the speaker: 进去. 进来 needs the speaker to be inside.

items.q: 小李不在这儿，他刚才出___买东西了。
items.zh: 小李不在这儿，他刚才出去买东西了。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ bù zài zhè r tā gāng cái chū qù mǎi dōng xī le
items.en: Xiao Li isn't here. He just went out to buy something.
items.why: He is not where the speaker is and the movement leads away from here: 出去. 出来 would mean coming out toward the speaker.

items.q: 售货员站在柜台里面说：“您过___看看这双鞋吧。”
items.zh: 售货员站在柜台里面说：“您过来看看这双鞋吧。”
items.py: shòu huò yuán zhàn zài guì tái lǐ miàn shuō ：“ nín guò lái kàn kàn zhè shuāng xié ba ”
items.en: The salesperson, standing behind the counter, says: "Come over and have a look at these shoes."
items.why: The salesperson is the speaker and wants the customer to cross the space toward her: 过来. 过去 would send the customer away from her.

items.q: 我已经在健身房里了，你拿着会员卡，直接走进___就行。
items.zh: 我已经在健身房里了，你拿着会员卡，直接走进来就行。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng zài jiàn shēn fáng lǐ le nǐ ná zhe huì yuán kǎ zhí jiē zǒu jìn lái jiù xíng
items.en: I'm already inside the gym. Just take your membership card and walk straight in.
items.why: The speaker is inside the gym, so the listener walks toward the speaker: 走进来. The tempting 去 matches English 'go in', but it ignores where the speaker is.

items.q: 请大家站___，我们拍一张照片。
items.zh: 请大家站起来，我们拍一张照片。
items.py: qǐng dà jiā zhàn qǐ lái wǒ men pāi yī zhāng zhào piān
items.en: Everyone, please stand up, so we can take a photo.
items.why: Standing up from a seat is 站起来: 起 only pairs with 来 and means rising with no destination. 站上来 would mean stepping up onto something.

items.q: 小王累了，在球场边的椅子上坐___休息。
items.zh: 小王累了，在球场边的椅子上坐下来休息。
items.py: xiǎo wáng lèi le zài qiú chǎng biān de yǐ zi shàng zuò xià lái xiū xī
items.en: Xiao Wang was tired and sat down on a chair beside the pitch to rest.
items.why: Sitting down is 坐下来: the body settles downward. 坐起来 means to sit up from lying, which does not fit resting on a chair.

items.q: 比赛一开始，观众们都站___大声喊加油。
items.zh: 比赛一开始，观众们都站起来大声喊加油。
items.py: bǐ sài yī kāi shǐ guān zhòng men dōu zhàn qǐ lái dà shēng hǎn jiā yóu
items.en: As soon as the match began, the spectators all stood up and shouted "Go!"
items.why: Rising from a seat is 站起来. 站下来 would mean coming to a halt, and 上去 and 出去 need a place they move to.

items.q: 钱包掉到地上了，他弯腰把它捡___。
items.zh: 钱包掉到地上了，他弯腰把它捡起来。
items.py: qián bāo diào dào dì shàng le tā wān yāo bǎ tā jiǎn qǐ lái
items.en: His wallet fell on the floor, and he bent down and picked it up.
items.why: Lifting something off the ground is 捡起来. 起 gives the upward movement, and the others (进去, 出来, 回去) need a container or a destination.

items.q: 看见好朋友在马路对面，小王高兴地跑___和他打招呼。
items.zh: 看见好朋友在马路对面，小王高兴地跑过去和他打招呼。
items.py: kàn jiàn hǎo péng yǒu zài mǎ lù duì miàn xiǎo wáng gāo xìng dì pǎo guò qù hé tā dǎ zhāo hū
items.en: Seeing his good friend across the road, Xiao Wang happily ran over to say hello.
items.why: Crossing the street away from the narrator is 跑过去. 进去 needs a building or enclosed space to enter, 下来 is about coming down, and 回去 means returning where he came from.

items.q: 比赛结束后，球迷们都从看台上走___，慢慢往外走。
items.zh: 比赛结束后，球迷们都从看台上走下来，慢慢往外走。
items.py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu qiú mí men dōu cóng kàn tái shàng zǒu xià lái màn màn wǎng wài zǒu
items.en: After the match, the fans all came down from the stands and slowly headed out.
items.why: Leaving a raised stand is a downward movement, 走下来. 走上去 goes up, 走起来 would be starting to walk, 走进去 goes inside.

items.q: 妈妈买完菜，已经回___去了。
items.zh: 妈妈买完菜，已经回家去了。
items.py: mā mā mǎi wán cài yǐ jīng huí jiā qù le
items.en: Mum finished buying vegetables and has already gone home.
items.why: The place 家 must come between 回 and 去. Nothing may follow 去 except 了, and 来, 里, 到 do not fit before 去.

items.q: 小李跑进___来，大声说今天打折。
items.zh: 小李跑进商店来，大声说今天打折。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ pǎo jìn shāng diàn lái dà shēng shuō jīn tiān dǎ zhé
items.en: Xiao Li ran into the shop and announced loudly that there was a discount today.
items.why: The place word goes between 进 and 来: 跑进商店来. Putting 来 or 去 in this slot would double up the direction word.

items.q: 买完运动鞋，我们就一起走上___去了。
items.zh: 买完运动鞋，我们就一起走上三楼去了。
items.py: mǎi wán yùn dòng xié wǒ men jiù yì qǐ zǒu shàng sān lóu qù le
items.en: After buying the sports shoes we walked up to the third floor together.
items.why: The destination 三楼 sits between 上 and 去: 走上三楼去了. A bare 来 or 去 in the blank would leave no place, and 在 is not a direction word.

items.q: 你什么时候回___来看这场比赛？
items.zh: 你什么时候回上海来看这场比赛？
items.py: nǐ shén me shí hòu huí shàng hǎi lái kàn zhè chǎng bǐ sài
items.en: When are you coming back to Shanghai to see this match?
items.why: A place follows the direction word and precedes 来: 回上海来. The sentence already ends the phrase with 来, so another 来 or 去 cannot fill the slot.

items.q: 比赛一结束，球迷们都跑进___去，围住了自己最喜欢的球员。
items.zh: 比赛一结束，球迷们都跑进球场去，围住了自己最喜欢的球员。
items.py: bǐ sài yī jié shù qiú mí men dōu pǎo jìn qiú chǎng qù wéi zhù le zì jǐ zuì xǐ huān de qiú yuán
items.en: As soon as the match ended, the fans all ran onto the pitch and surrounded their favourite player.
items.why: The place 球场 goes between 进 and 去. 到球场 would add a second direction word, and a bare 来 or 去 leaves out the place.

items.q: 我们在门口付了钱，然后一起走进___去看比赛。
items.zh: 我们在门口付了钱，然后一起走进体育馆去看比赛。
items.py: wǒ men zài mén kǒu fù le qián rán hòu yì qǐ zǒu jìn tǐ yù guǎn qù kàn bǐ sài
items.en: We paid at the entrance and then walked into the stadium together to watch the match.
items.why: The place 体育馆 belongs between 进 and 去: 走进体育馆去. 走进去体育馆 puts the place after 去, which is never allowed.

items.q: 小王从包里拿出一张银行卡___，付了钱。
items.zh: 小王从包里拿出一张银行卡来，付了钱。
items.py: xiǎo wáng cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhāng yín háng kǎ lái fù le qián
items.en: Xiao Wang took a bank card out of his bag and paid.
items.why: A thing taken out of a container comes toward the person with it: 拿出一张银行卡来. 去 would send it away, and 起 or 上 mean other things.

items.q: 朋友从国外给我带___了一双运动鞋。
items.zh: 朋友从国外给我带来了一双运动鞋。
items.py: péng yǒu cóng guó wài gěi wǒ dài lái le yī shuāng yùn dòng xié
items.en: A friend brought me a pair of sports shoes from abroad.
items.why: The shoes arrive to me, so the direction word is 来: 带来了. 带去 would mean taking something away from the speaker.

items.q: 老板想了半天，终于从抽屉里拿___一张发票来。
items.zh: 老板想了半天，终于从抽屉里拿出一张发票来。
items.py: lǎo bǎn xiǎng le bàn tiān zhōng yú cóng chōu ti lǐ ná chū yī zhāng fā piào lái
items.en: After thinking for a long time, the boss finally took a receipt out of the drawer.
items.why: Something coming out of a drawer is 拿出...来. 进 goes in, and 上 and 下 describe height, so only 出 fits 从抽屉里.

items.q: 请___这些苹果拿进去。
items.zh: 请把这些苹果拿进去。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè xiē píng guǒ ná jìn qù
items.en: Please take these apples inside.
items.why: The specific apples are moved, so 把 puts them before 拿进去. 被 would make them the doer, and 对 and 让 do not form this pattern.

items.q: 售货员没___新衣服拿出来给我看。
items.zh: 售货员没把新衣服拿出来给我看。
items.py: shòu huò yuán méi bǎ xīn yī fú ná chū lái gěi wǒ kàn
items.en: The shop assistant didn't take the new clothes out to show me.
items.why: The thing being moved needs 把, with 没 placed before it: 没把...拿出来. 被 and 对 give a different meaning, and 给 cannot introduce the moved object.

items.q: 这些钱你先___它存进银行去吧。
items.zh: 这些钱你先把它存进银行去吧。
items.py: zhè xiē qián nǐ xiān bǎ tā cún jìn yín háng qù ba
items.en: Put this money into the bank first.
items.why: 把 + object + verb + direction + place + 去 moves the money. The object 它 has to precede the verb, so 被, 对 and 向 are not possible here.

items.q: 我帮你把行李拿上___去。
items.zh: 我帮你把行李拿上楼去。
items.py: wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ xíng li ná shàng lóu qù
items.en: I'll help you carry the luggage upstairs.
items.why: Inside a 把 sentence the place word still goes between the direction word and 去: 拿上楼去. 拿上去楼 breaks the place rule.

items.q: 你应该___这双旧球鞋拿回商店去换。
items.zh: 你应该把这双旧球鞋拿回商店去换。
items.py: nǐ yīng gāi bǎ zhè shuāng jiù qiú xié ná huí shāng diàn qù huàn
items.en: You should take these old sports shoes back to the shop and exchange them.
items.why: The modal 应该 sits before 把, and the pair of shoes is moved: 把...拿回商店去. The other options cannot take the object before 拿回.

items.q: 比赛一开始，大家都喊___了。
items.zh: 比赛一开始，大家都喊起来了。
items.py: bǐ sài yī kāi shǐ dà jiā dōu hǎn qǐ lái le
items.en: As soon as the match began, everybody started shouting.
items.why: The action starts and builds up, which is 起来. 下去 would be continuing a shout already underway, and 下来 means settling down.

items.q: 这双运动鞋看___很贵，其实很便宜。
items.zh: 这双运动鞋看起来很贵，其实很便宜。
items.py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié kàn qǐ lái hěn guì qí shí hěn pián yi
items.en: These sports shoes look expensive, but they are actually cheap.
items.why: An impression from looking is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 means working something out, and it cannot take a comment like 很贵 directly.

items.q: 外面突然下___大雨来，比赛只好停了。
items.zh: 外面突然下起大雨来，比赛只好停了。
items.py: wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ dà yǔ lái bǐ sài zhǐ hǎo tíng le
items.en: It suddenly started pouring outside, so the match had to stop.
items.why: The object 大雨 goes inside 起来: 下起大雨来 for something starting. 下出 and 下上 are not forms, and 下下 does not combine with 来.

items.q: 这双球鞋穿___很舒服，我想再买一双。
items.zh: 这双球鞋穿起来很舒服，我想再买一双。
items.py: zhè shuāng qiú xié chuān qǐ lái hěn shū fú wǒ xiǎng zài mǎi yī shuāng
items.en: These shoes are comfortable to wear, so I want to buy another pair.
items.why: 穿起来 + comment gives how something feels to wear. 穿过来 and 穿出来 do not carry that meaning, and 穿上去 only describes putting something on.

items.q: 天气一暖和，公园里打球的人就多___了。
items.zh: 天气一暖和，公园里打球的人就多起来了。
items.py: tiān qì yī nuǎn huo gōng yuán lǐ dǎ qiú de rén jiù duō qǐ lái le
items.en: As soon as the weather warmed up, more and more people started playing ball in the park.
items.why: A number that grows takes 起来: 多起来了. 下来 is for things that settle, quiet or slow, which is the opposite direction.

items.q: 他们几个一见面就聊___篮球来，常常聊到商店关门。
items.zh: 他们几个一见面就聊起篮球来，常常聊到商店关门。
items.py: tā men jǐ gè yī jiàn miàn jiù liáo qǐ lán qiú lái cháng cháng liáo dào shāng diàn guān mén
items.en: As soon as they meet, the few of them start talking basketball and often chat until the shop closes.
items.why: Starting a topic with an object puts the object inside: 聊起篮球来. 聊出篮球 and 聊下篮球 would give a different meaning or none.

items.q: 这家店的价格听___不错，我们进去看看吧。
items.zh: 这家店的价格听起来不错，我们进去看看吧。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé tīng qǐ lái bù cuò wǒ men jìn qù kàn kàn ba
items.en: The prices at this shop sound good, so let's go in and take a look.
items.why: 听起来 + comment is the impression from what you hear. 听出来 would claim you worked something out, 听下去 means keep listening, and 听过来 is not a form.

items.q: 别停，你继续跑___，还有两圈。
items.zh: 别停，你继续跑下去，还有两圈。
items.py: bié tíng nǐ jì xù pǎo xià qù hái yǒu liǎng quān
items.en: Don't stop, keep running. There are two laps left.
items.why: The runner carries on from now on, which is 下去. 下来 would mean having come to rest, and 起来 would be starting to run.

items.q: 球赛太精彩了，他们一边喝水一边看___。
items.zh: 球赛太精彩了，他们一边喝水一边看下去。
items.py: qiú sài tài jīng cǎi le tā men yī biān hē shuǐ yī biān kàn xià qù
items.en: The match was so thrilling that they drank water while they kept on watching.
items.why: Carrying on with a match that is under way is 看下去. 看下来 would be having sat through it, and 看起来 means 'looks'.

items.q: 教练说：“请大家停___，休息五分钟。”
items.zh: 教练说：“请大家停下来，休息五分钟。”
items.py: jiào liàn shuō ：“ qǐng dà jiā tíng xià lái xiū xī wǔ fēn zhōng ”
items.en: The coach said, "Everyone, please stop and rest for five minutes."
items.why: Coming to a stop is 停下来. 停下去 is not used, and 停起来 would be starting to stop.

items.q: 听到哨声，吵闹的球场慢慢安静___了。
items.zh: 听到哨声，吵闹的球场慢慢安静下来了。
items.py: tīng dào shào shēng chǎo nào de qiú chǎng màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
items.en: At the sound of the whistle, the noisy pitch slowly quietened down.
items.why: Getting quieter settles downward: 安静下来. 安静下去 would mean staying quiet from now on, and 过来 or 出来 do not describe a noisy place calming down.

items.q: 你每个月都买这么多东西，再这样买___，钱很快就会花完。
items.zh: 你每个月都买这么多东西，再这样买下去，钱很快就会花完。
items.py: nǐ měi gè yuè dōu mǎi zhè me duō dōng xī zài zhè yàng mǎi xià qù qián hěn kuài jiù huì huā wán
items.en: You buy so much every month. If you keep buying like this, the money will soon run out.
items.why: 再这样 + verb + 下去 means keep doing it from now on. 起来 would be starting to buy, and 下来 means something has already been settled.

items.q: 东西太多了，我怕忘了，先把价钱记___吧。
items.zh: 东西太多了，我怕忘了，先把价钱记下来吧。
items.py: dōng xī tài duō le wǒ pà wàng le xiān bǎ jià qián jì xià lái ba
items.en: There are so many things that I'm afraid I'll forget. Let me note the prices down first.
items.why: Fixing something so it is not lost is 记下来. 记下去 would be going on remembering, and 记出来 or 记过来 are not 'write down'.

items.q: 他在网球场练了三年，虽然很辛苦，但是终于坚持___了。
items.zh: 他在网球场练了三年，虽然很辛苦，但是终于坚持下来了。
items.py: tā zài wǎng qiú chǎng liàn le sān nián suī rán hěn xīn kǔ dàn shì zhōng yú jiān chí xià lái le
items.en: He trained at the tennis court for three years. It was hard, but he finally stuck it out.
items.why: The three years are over and the persistence is complete, so 坚持下来了. 坚持起来 would be starting to persist, and 上去 or 出来 do not mean having stuck it out.

items.q: 这家运动用品店的老板想让我留___工作，可是我已经买好回国的票了。
items.zh: 这家运动用品店的老板想让我留下来工作，可是我已经买好回国的票了。
items.py: zhè jiā yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn de lǎo bǎn xiǎng ràng wǒ liú xià lái gōng zuò kě shì wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo huí guó de piào le
items.en: The owner of this sports shop wanted me to stay on and work, but I had already bought my ticket home.
items.why: Staying in a place is 留下来. 留下去 and 留起来 do not express staying, and 留出来 means setting something aside.

items.q: 我一看就看___这件衣服是假的。
items.zh: 我一看就看出来这件衣服是假的。
items.py: wǒ yī kàn jiù kàn chū lái zhè jiàn yī fú shì jiǎ de
items.en: I could tell at a glance that this piece of clothing is a fake.
items.why: Working out something hidden by looking is 看出来. 看起来 only gives an impression and could not be followed by a verdict like 是假的 in this way.

items.q: 电话里的声音很小，可是我一听就听___是教练。
items.zh: 电话里的声音很小，可是我一听就听出来是教练。
items.py: diàn huà lǐ de shēng yīn hěn xiǎo kě shì wǒ yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái shì jiào liàn
items.en: The voice on the phone was very faint, but I recognised it as the coach the moment I heard it.
items.why: Recognising by sound is 听出来. 听起来 would be 'sounds like', and it cannot repeat the verb after 一听就.

items.q: 以前没有人想过，是他第一个想___了这个省钱的办法。
items.zh: 以前没有人想过，是他第一个想出了这个省钱的办法。
items.py: yǐ qián méi yǒu rén xiǎng guò shì tā dì yí gè xiǎng chū le zhè ge shěng qián de bàn fǎ
items.en: Nobody had thought of it before. He was the first to come up with this way of saving money.
items.why: Inventing something new is 想出. 想起 is only for recalling something you already knew, which does not fit a brand-new idea.

items.q: 我终于想___他的名字了，他叫小李！
items.zh: 我终于想起他的名字了，他叫小李！
items.py: wǒ zhōng yú xiǎng qǐ tā de míng zì le tā jiào xiǎo lǐ
items.en: I finally remembered his name, he is called Xiao Li!
items.why: A name you already knew is recalled: 想起. 想出 is for creating something new, such as an idea or a plan.

items.q: 你说___你想要什么颜色，我们才能帮你选。
items.zh: 你说出来你想要什么颜色，我们才能帮你选。
items.py: nǐ shuō chū lái nǐ xiǎng yào shén me yán sè wǒ men cái néng bāng nǐ xuǎn
items.en: Tell us which colour you want, and then we can help you choose.
items.why: Putting a hidden wish into words is 说出来. 说起来 means 'speaking of', and 说下来 or 说上去 are not forms that fit.

items.q: 她换了发型，变化很大，我差一点没认___，以为是别人。
items.zh: 她换了发型，变化很大，我差一点没认出来，以为是别人。
items.py: tā huàn le fà xíng biàn huà hěn dà wǒ chà yì diǎn méi rèn chū lái yǐ wéi shì bié rén
items.en: She changed her hairstyle and looks so different that I almost didn't recognise her and thought it was someone else.
items.why: Telling who someone is by looking is 认出来. 认起来 and 认下去 are not words, and 认上去 does not exist either.

items.q: 这台游戏机是他自己做___的，比商店里卖的还好。
items.zh: 这台游戏机是他自己做出来的，比商店里卖的还好。
items.py: zhè tái yóu xì jī shì tā zì jǐ zuò chū lái de bǐ shāng diàn lǐ mài de hái hǎo
items.en: He made this game console himself, and it is even better than the ones sold in shops.
items.why: Making something that did not exist is 做出来. 做起来 would be 'when it comes to doing it', and 做下来 means finishing a long stretch.

items.q: 天太冷了，你把外套穿___吧。
items.zh: 天太冷了，你把外套穿上吧。
items.py: tiān tài lěng le nǐ bǎ wài tào chuān shàng ba
items.en: It's too cold, put your coat on.
items.why: Putting on clothes is 穿上: the item attaches to the body. 穿下 means taking off (it is not used alone), and 穿出来 or 穿起来 do not mean put on.

items.q: 出门的时候，请把门关___。
items.zh: 出门的时候，请把门关上。
items.py: chū mén de shí hòu qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng
items.en: When you go out, please close the door.
items.why: Shutting is 关上: the door joins the frame. The others are directional movements and give no closing sense.

items.q: 我弟弟今年终于考___了他最想去的体育大学。
items.zh: 我弟弟今年终于考上了他最想去的体育大学。
items.py: wǒ dì di jīn nián zhōng yú kǎo shàng le tā zuì xiǎng qù de tǐ yù dà xué
items.en: My younger brother finally got into the sports university he most wanted to attend this year.
items.why: Reaching a goal like entering a school is 考上. 考下 and 考起 are not used here, and 考回 would mean taking an exam back.

items.q: 他在商店里看到一个很可爱的小熊，一下子就爱___了它。
items.zh: 他在商店里看到一个很可爱的小熊，一下子就爱上了它。
items.py: tā zài shāng diàn lǐ kàn dào yí gè hěn kě ài de xiǎo xióng yī xià zi jiù ài shàng le tā
items.en: He saw a very cute little bear in the shop and fell in love with it at once.
items.why: Falling for something is 爱上: a new state begins. 爱出 and 爱起 are not words, and 爱过 would mean having loved it before.

items.q: 他踢球时撞到头晕倒了，过了一分钟才醒___。
items.zh: 他踢球时撞到头晕倒了，过了一分钟才醒过来。
items.py: tā tī qiú shí zhuàng dào tóu yūn dǎo le guò le yì fēn zhōng cái xǐng guò lái
items.en: He hit his head while playing football and passed out, and only came round after a minute.
items.why: Coming back to consciousness is 醒过来. 醒过去 reverses it, 醒起来 is not used, and 醒出来 does not exist.

items.q: 我站在球场这边，看见对面的三个孩子正朝我走___。
items.zh: 我站在球场这边，看见对面的三个孩子正朝我走过来。
items.py: wǒ zhàn zài qiú chǎng zhè biān kàn jiàn duì miàn de sān gè hái zi zhèng cháo wǒ zǒu guò lái
items.en: I'm standing on this side of the pitch and see three children on the far side walking toward me.
items.why: They cross toward the speaker, so 走过来. 走过去 is away from me, and 走起来 or 走下来 do not describe crossing.

items.zh: 她买完东西就回家去了。
items.py: tā mǎi wán dōng xī jiù huí jiā qù le
items.en: After she finished shopping, she went home.
items.why: The place 回家 comes before 去, and 去 closes the phrase. 回去家 is impossible because a place cannot follow 去.

items.zh: 孩子们都跑进商店来了。
items.py: hái zi men dōu pǎo jìn shāng diàn lái le
items.en: The children all ran into the shop.
items.why: The place 商店 splits 跑进 and 来: 跑进商店来. Putting 商店 after 来 would break the place rule.

items.zh: 比赛结束后球迷们都走出体育馆去了。
items.py: bǐ sài jié shù hòu qiú mí men dōu zǒu chū tǐ yù guǎn qù le
items.en: After the match, the fans all walked out of the stadium.
items.why: 走出体育馆去 puts the place between 出 and 去. The time phrase may sit before or after the subject, but 体育馆 must stay before 去.

items.zh: 她从包里拿出一张优惠券来。
items.py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhāng yōu huì quàn lái
items.en: She took a coupon out of her bag.
items.why: A thing object can go before 来 (拿出一张优惠券来) or after it (拿出来一张优惠券). The direction word 出 stays right after 拿.

items.zh: 请你带一个球来。
items.py: qǐng nǐ dài yí gè qiú lái
items.en: Please bring a ball.
items.why: A thing object may stand before or after 来. The verb 带 comes first, with 来 either before or after the object.

items.zh: 我把新球拍带回家去了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ xīn qiú pāi dài huí jiā qù le
items.en: I took the new racket home.
items.why: 把 puts the new racket before the verb. The place 回家 stays before 去, and 了 goes last.

items.zh: 请你把这些衣服搬进来。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè xiē yī fú bān jìn lái
items.en: Please carry these clothes in.
items.why: 把 and its object come before the verb, and the whole 搬进来 stays together at the end. 搬进来把这些衣服 is wrong.

items.zh: 老板没把那箱运动饮料从仓库里搬出来。
items.py: lǎo bǎn méi bǎ nà xiāng yùn dòng yǐn liào cóng cāng kù lǐ bān chū lái
items.en: The boss didn't carry that case of sports drinks out of the warehouse.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, never after it. 从仓库里 may come before 把 or between the object and the verb, and 搬出来 stays together.

items.zh: 我帮你把这箱水果搬上楼去。
items.py: wǒ bāng nǐ bǎ zhè xiāng shuǐ guǒ bān shàng lóu qù
items.en: I'll help you carry this box of fruit upstairs.
items.why: 把 + object + verb + direction + place + 去. The place 楼 must come before 去, so 搬上去楼 is wrong.

items.zh: 这双球鞋看起来很新。
items.py: zhè shuāng qiú xié kàn qǐ lái hěn xīn
items.en: These sports shoes look new.
items.why: 看起来 + comment gives an impression. The comment 很新 comes after 起来, and 看出来很新 would mean something else.

items.zh: 请你把这个价格写下来。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè ge jià gé xiě xià lái
items.en: Please write this price down.
items.why: Fixing something on paper is 写下来, and the object goes after 把. 写下去 would mean keep writing, and 写下来把这个价格 breaks the 把 order.

items.zh: 比赛开始前球场慢慢安静下来了。
items.py: bǐ sài kāi shǐ qián qiú chǎng màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
items.en: Before the match began, the pitch slowly went quiet.
items.why: Quieting is 安静下来: 下来 attaches directly to the adjective. The time phrase may stand before or after 球场, but 慢慢 stays before 安静.

items.zh: 他一听就听出来是教练的声音。
items.py: tā yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái shì jiào liàn de shēng yīn
items.en: He could tell it was the coach's voice the moment he heard it.
items.why: 一听就听出来 means he recognised the voice. 听出来 is followed by the clause 是教练的声音, so the complement stays attached to 听.

items.zh: 老板把店门关上了。
items.py: lǎo bǎn bǎ diàn mén guān shàng le
items.en: The boss closed the shop door.
items.why: 把 + object + 关上 + 了: 上 means closing, and 了 goes at the end. 关上了店门把 and 把关上店门 are wrong.

items.src: 那件外套，妈妈拿回来了。
items.src_py: nà jiàn wài tào mā mā ná huí lái le
items.zh: 妈妈把那件外套拿回来了。
items.py: mā mā bǎ nà jiàn wài tào ná huí lái le
items.en: Mum brought that coat back.
items.why: 把 moves the topic-fronted object 那件外套 in front of the verb, and the complement 拿回来 and 了 stay together at the end.

items.src: 那双球鞋，售货员拿出来给我看了。
items.src_py: nà shuāng qiú xié shòu huò yuán ná chū lái gěi wǒ kàn le
items.zh: 售货员把那双球鞋拿出来给我看了。
items.py: shòu huò yuán bǎ nà shuāng qiú xié ná chū lái gěi wǒ kàn le
items.en: The shop assistant took out those shoes and showed them to me.
items.why: 把 brings the object 那双球鞋 before the verb. 拿出来 stays together, and 给我看了 follows as the second action.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ qián bāo dài huí lái le
items.zh: 我没把钱包带回来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ qián bāo dài huí lái
items.en: I didn't bring my wallet back.
items.why: The negative 没 goes before 把, and the 了 of the positive sentence disappears: 我没把钱包带回来.

items.src: 她把新球拍拿上楼去了。
items.src_py: tā bǎ xīn qiú pāi ná shàng lóu qù le
items.zh: 她没把新球拍拿上楼去。
items.py: tā méi bǎ xīn qiú pāi ná shàng lóu qù
items.en: She didn't take the new racket upstairs.
items.why: 没 stands before 把 and 了 is dropped. The place 楼 still sits between 上 and 去: 拿上楼去.

items.src_py: wài miàn xià yǔ le
items.zh: 外面下起雨来了。
items.py: wài miàn xià qǐ yǔ lái le
items.en: It started raining outside.
items.why: Starting uses 起来 with the object inside it: 下起雨来了. 下雨起来 breaks the rule.

items.src: 我觉得那家店的东西很贵。
items.src_py: wǒ jué de nà jiā diàn de dōng xī hěn guì
items.zh: 那家店的东西看起来很贵。
items.py: nà jiā diàn de dōng xī kàn qǐ lái hěn guì
items.en: The things in that shop look expensive.
items.why: 看起来 + comment expresses an impression. The thing being judged becomes the subject, and the comment 很贵 follows.

items.src_py: qǐng nǐ xiě zhè ge hào mǎ
items.task: Say "write it down" with 下来.
items.zh: 请你把这个号码写下来。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè ge hào mǎ xiě xià lái
items.en: Please write this number down.
items.why: Making a note so it is not lost uses 写下来 with 把 and the object before the verb. 写下去 would mean continuing to write.

items.src_py: zhè yàng mǎi dōng xī qián huì bù gòu
items.task: Say "if you keep on like this" with 下去.
items.zh: 再这样买下去钱会不够。
items.py: zài zhè yàng mǎi xià qù qián huì bù gòu
items.en: If we keep on buying like this, the money won't be enough.
items.why: 再这样买下去 means continuing a habit from now on. 下去 ends the first clause and takes no object, so the result 钱会不够 follows.

items.src_py: wǒ zhī dào zhè ge bāo shì jiǎ de
items.task: Say you could tell by looking, with 看出来.
items.zh: 我看出来这个包是假的。
items.py: wǒ kàn chū lái zhè ge bāo shì jiǎ de
items.en: I can tell this bag is a fake.
items.why: Working something out by looking is 看出来, followed by the clause 这个包是假的. 看起来 would only report an impression.

items.src_py: tā chuān shàng le wài tào
items.zh: 他把外套穿上了。
items.py: tā bǎ wài tào chuān shàng le
items.en: He put his coat on.
items.why: 把 puts the coat before the verb; 穿上 keeps its 上 and 了 follows at the end.

items.s: 我在楼下等你，你快下去吧。
items.s_py: wǒ zài lóu xià děng nǐ nǐ kuài xià qù ba
items.zh: 我在楼下等你，你快下来吧。
items.py: wǒ zài lóu xià děng nǐ nǐ kuài xià lái ba
items.en: I'm waiting downstairs, come down quickly.
items.why: The speaker is downstairs, so the listener moves toward the speaker: 下来. 下去 would be used if the speaker were upstairs.

items.s: 我在商店外面等，朋友们都进去看球鞋了。
items.s_py: wǒ zài shāng diàn wài miàn děng péng yǒu men dōu jìn qù kàn qiú xié le
items.zh: 我在商店外面等，朋友们都进去看球鞋了。
items.py: wǒ zài shāng diàn wài miàn děng péng yǒu men dōu jìn qù kàn qiú xié le
items.en: I'm waiting outside the shop, and my friends have all gone in to look at sports shoes.
items.why: The speaker is outside, so going in is away from the speaker: 进去. It looks like it needs 来 because of English 'come in', but the speaker's place decides it.

items.s: 他跑进去商店买了一瓶水。
items.s_py: tā pǎo jìn qù shāng diàn mǎi le yī píng shuǐ
items.zh: 他跑进商店去买了一瓶水。
items.py: tā pǎo jìn shāng diàn qù mǎi le yī píng shuǐ
items.en: He ran into the shop and bought a bottle of water.
items.why: The place 商店 cannot follow 进去. It goes between 进 and 去: 跑进商店去. Both 进 and 去 are fine; the order is what is wrong.

items.s: 你什么时候回上海来买新手机？
items.s_py: nǐ shén me shí hòu huí shàng hǎi lái mǎi xīn shǒu jī
items.zh: 你什么时候回上海来买新手机？
items.py: nǐ shén me shí hòu huí shàng hǎi lái mǎi xīn shǒu jī
items.en: When are you coming back to Shanghai to buy a new phone?
items.why: The place 上海 sits between 回 and 来, which is the correct order. The sentence looks odd because the verb 买 follows 来, but 来 is closing the direction phrase.

items.s: 他从包里拿来出一张卡。
items.s_py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná lái chū yī zhāng kǎ
items.zh: 他从包里拿出一张卡来。
items.py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhāng kǎ lái
items.en: He took a card out of his bag.
items.why: The direction word comes right after the verb (拿出) and 来 follows it. 拿来出 swaps the two parts.

items.s: 她从钱包里拿出来一百块钱。
items.s_py: tā cóng qián bāo lǐ ná chū lái yì bǎi kuài qián
items.zh: 她从钱包里拿出来一百块钱。
items.py: tā cóng qián bāo lǐ ná chū lái yì bǎi kuài qián
items.en: She took one hundred yuan out of her wallet.
items.why: A thing object can come after 来: 拿出来一百块钱 is just as correct as 拿出一百块钱来. It looks wrong only if you think 来 must be last.

items.s: 他把新球拍带回去学校了。
items.s_py: tā bǎ xīn qiú pāi dài huí qù xué xiào le
items.zh: 他把新球拍带回学校去了。
items.py: tā bǎ xīn qiú pāi dài huí xué xiào qù le
items.en: He took his new racket back to school.
items.why: The place 学校 must come between 回 and 去. 带回去学校 puts the place after 去, which is not allowed even inside a 把 sentence.

items.s: 我没把那双球鞋带回来。
items.s_py: wǒ méi bǎ nà shuāng qiú xié dài huí lái
items.zh: 我没把那双球鞋带回来。
items.py: wǒ méi bǎ nà shuāng qiú xié dài huí lái
items.en: I didn't bring those shoes back.
items.why: The negative 没 goes before 把, and the complement 带回来 stays with the verb. A learner may want 了, but 没 already rules it out.

items.s: 我把带出来钱包了。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ dài chū lái qián bāo le
items.zh: 我把钱包带出来了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ qián bāo dài chū lái le
items.en: I brought my wallet out.
items.why: The object of 把 must come right after 把 and before the verb. 把带出来钱包 leaves 把 with no object and puts the thing after the complement.

items.s: 老板想把那些旧运动鞋都搬出去卖掉。
items.s_py: lǎo bǎn xiǎng bǎ nà xiē jiù yùn dòng xié dōu bān chū qù mài diào
items.zh: 老板想把那些旧运动鞋都搬出去卖掉。
items.py: lǎo bǎn xiǎng bǎ nà xiē jiù yùn dòng xié dōu bān chū qù mài diào
items.en: The boss wants to carry all those old sports shoes out and sell them.
items.why: 想 goes before 把, and 都 sits with the object. The movement ends away from where the boss stands: 搬出去, with 卖掉 as the next step.

items.s: 球场上突然下雨起来了。
items.s_py: qiú chǎng shàng tū rán xià yǔ qǐ lái le
items.zh: 球场上突然下起雨来了。
items.py: qiú chǎng shàng tū rán xià qǐ yǔ lái le
items.en: It suddenly started to rain on the pitch.
items.why: With 起来 meaning start, the object 雨 goes between 起 and 来: 下起雨来. 下雨起来 puts it before 起来.

items.s: 这双鞋穿起来很舒服，价格也不贵。
items.s_py: zhè shuāng xié chuān qǐ lái hěn shū fú jià gé yě bù guì
items.zh: 这双鞋穿起来很舒服，价格也不贵。
items.py: zhè shuāng xié chuān qǐ lái hěn shū fú jià gé yě bù guì
items.en: These shoes are comfortable to wear, and the price isn't high either.
items.why: 穿起来 + comment is a correct impression pattern. It looks wrong if you expect 起来 to mean standing up, but here it simply gives how it feels.

items.s: 你看出来很高兴。
items.s_py: nǐ kàn chū lái hěn gāo xìng
items.zh: 你看起来很高兴。
items.py: nǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng
items.en: You look happy.
items.why: An impression of how someone looks is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 means to work something out, and it cannot be followed by a bare comment like 很高兴.

items.s: 这个游戏说起来简单，做起来却不容易。
items.s_py: zhè ge yóu xì shuō qǐ lái jiǎn dān zuò qǐ lái què bù róng yì
items.zh: 这个游戏说起来简单，做起来却不容易。
items.py: zhè ge yóu xì shuō qǐ lái jiǎn dān zuò qǐ lái què bù róng yì
items.en: This game is easy to explain but not easy to do.
items.why: 说起来 and 做起来 are standard 'when it comes to' contrasts, and 起来 is not about starting. A learner may wonder if 起 should split off, but here it should not.

items.s: 老板说价格会变，你最好把它写下去。
items.s_py: lǎo bǎn shuō jià gé huì biàn nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ tā xiě xià qù
items.zh: 老板说价格会变，你最好把它写下来。
items.py: lǎo bǎn shuō jià gé huì biàn nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ tā xiě xià lái
items.en: The boss said the price will change, so you'd better write it down.
items.why: Recording something so it is not lost is 写下来. 写下去 means to carry on writing, which does not fit a note of the price.

items.s: 这样的比赛虽然很累，但是我想看下去。
items.s_py: zhè yàng de bǐ sài suī rán hěn lèi dàn shì wǒ xiǎng kàn xià qù
items.zh: 这样的比赛虽然很累，但是我想看下去。
items.py: zhè yàng de bǐ sài suī rán hěn lèi dàn shì wǒ xiǎng kàn xià qù
items.en: Even though a match like this is tiring, I want to keep watching.
items.why: 看下去 means carry on watching, with no object after 下去. It looks wrong only if you want an object, but the match is already understood.

items.s: 车在店门口停起来了。
items.s_py: chē zài diàn mén kǒu tíng qǐ lái le
items.zh: 车在店门口停下来了。
items.py: chē zài diàn mén kǒu tíng xià lái le
items.en: The car came to a stop at the shop entrance.
items.why: Coming to a stop is 停下来. 停起来 would mean something is starting, which the verb 停 cannot do.

items.s: 为了省钱，她想出来一个好办法。
items.s_py: wèi le shěng qián tā xiǎng chū lái yí gè hǎo bàn fǎ
items.zh: 为了省钱，她想出来一个好办法。
items.py: wèi le shěng qián tā xiǎng chū lái yí gè hǎo bàn fǎ
items.en: To save money, she came up with a good idea.
items.why: Creating a new idea is 想出来. It looks wrong if you confuse it with recalling, but a new method did not exist before, so 出来 is right.

items.s: 出去的时候请把门关上去。
items.s_py: chū qù de shí hòu qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng qù
items.zh: 出去的时候请把门关上。
items.py: chū qù de shí hòu qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng
items.en: When you go out, please close the door.
items.why: 关上 already says the door is shut, so no 来/去 may be added. Adding 去 makes the door move away, which is meaningless.

items.s: 他踢了一年球，终于考上了体育大学。
items.s_py: tā tī le yī nián qiú zhōng yú kǎo shàng le tǐ yù dà xué
items.zh: 他踢了一年球，终于考上了体育大学。
items.py: tā tī le yī nián qiú zhōng yú kǎo shàng le tǐ yù dà xué
items.en: He played football for a year and finally got into the sports university.
items.why: 考上 means reaching a goal, with no 来/去. It may look as if it needs 到 or 进, but 上 is the normal complement for getting into a school.

items.q: 朋友的家在河对面，我们明天走过___找他。
items.zh: 朋友的家在河对面，我们明天走过去找他。
items.py: péng you de jiā zài hé duì miàn wǒ men míng tiān zǒu guò qù zhǎo tā
items.en: My friend's home is across the river, and we will walk over to see him tomorrow.
items.why: We are on this bank and the home is on the far side, away from the speaker, so 过去. 过来 would need the friend to be on our side.

items.q: 我正在屋里看电视，朋友走___了。
items.zh: 我正在屋里看电视，朋友走进屋来了。
items.py: wǒ zhèng zài wū lǐ kàn diàn shì péng you zǒu jìn wū lái le
items.en: I was watching TV in the room when my friend walked in.
items.why: The place 屋 splits 进 and 来: 进屋来. Putting 屋 after 来 (进来屋) is the classic error.

items.s: 这条路看出来很远，其实不远。
items.s_py: zhè tiáo lù kàn chū lái hěn yuǎn qí shí bù yuǎn
items.zh: 这条路看起来很远，其实不远。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù kàn qǐ lái hěn yuǎn qí shí bù yuǎn
items.en: This road looks far, but it really isn't.
items.why: An impression is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 means you work something out, and cannot be followed by 很远 in this way.

items.s: 雨下了一整天，大家只好留下来在家里聊天。
items.s_py: yǔ xià le yī zhěng tiān dà jiā zhǐ hǎo liú xià lái zài jiā lǐ liáo tiān
items.zh: 雨下了一整天，大家只好留下来在家里聊天。
items.py: yǔ xià le yī zhěng tiān dà jiā zhǐ hǎo liú xià lái zài jiā lǐ liáo tiān
items.en: It rained all day, so everyone had to stay in and chat at home.
items.why: Staying on is 留下来. 下去 would be wrong here because the group is staying put, not continuing something.

items.s: 她看起来很高兴，好像有什么好事。
items.s_py: tā kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng hǎo xiàng yǒu shén me hǎo shì
items.zh: 她看起来很高兴，好像有什么好事。
items.py: tā kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo xìng hǎo xiàng yǒu shén me hǎo shì
items.en: She looks happy, as if something good has happened.
